incident-bot: CRITICAL ALERT — dedicated pool 'sable-enterprise' (vpc-sable-01) GPU util 99%, request queue = 182, autoscale attempt failed (max_capacity_reached). Incident ID INC-2026-042.
incident-bot: Links: <https://dashboard.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-042> · triggered at 2026-03-15T14:57:02Z.
aj: I'm oncall SRE, taking ownership. Looking at metrics — p50 tokens/sec dropped, p95 latency ~12s. Attaching logs next.
luca: From infra side: autoscale hit max_instances=8. Cloud quota blocking new GPU allocation; provider returned "quota_exceeded" on last attempt.
maya: CS pinged Sable primary contact (ops@sable.ai). Notified they may see errors in production.
sre-lead: This is a P1. Quick mitigations to consider: 1) enable customer's pre-approved quantized variant, 2) manual burst (contractual reserved capacity), 3) throttle non-critical workloads. Need decisions and owners.
solutions-eng: Customer has tight data residency — hosted fallback is off the table without explicit OK. They pre-authorized a quant variant 'sable-quant-v1' for emergencies.
aj: Plan: 1) roll pool to 'sable-quant-v1' canary (100% if safe) 2) submit quota bump + manual burst request to infra 3) throttle background batch jobs in pool. I'm executing step 1 now.
customer-ops: Sable on call: "Confirm we accept quantized emergency variant for up to 2 hours while you stabilize."
luca: Running canary switch: `/deploy model-switch --pool vpc-sable-01 --from sable-main --to sable-quant-v1 --canary 20%` then escalate to 100% if metrics good.
aj: Canary at 20% -> queue decreased 40% in 45s. Moving to 100% canary.
incident-bot: ACTION LOG — aj set model canary to 100% at 2026-03-15T14:59:11Z.
pagerduty: [pagerduty] aj acknowledged INC-2026-042 (ack at 2026-03-15T14:59:45Z).
maya: Customer CS confirms acceptance of quant variant. They requested regular updates every 15m.
luca: Submitted infra quota bump request Q-8891 (provider ticket #GT-44512) for +2 GPUs. ETA unknown; marking as high priority. Also initiated throttling of background job queue (kill job ids: 3421,3423).
aj: After switch: queue=18, p95=2.4s, throughput recovering. Monitoring closely.
sre-lead: If quota bump denied within 10m, authorize manual burst to shared reserved pool under emergency clause. Solutions-eng, confirm contract ok for that?
solutions-eng: Confirmed: Sable's contract includes emergency burst allowance up to 4 GPUs for up to 3 hours with written notice. Legal requested to be CC'd if data leaves VPC.
customer-ops: Please CC legal@redwood.ai if any step uses non-VPC resources.
aj: Noted. For now, incident state = mitigated (reduced impact). Continuing monitoring and follow-up actions: postmortem, update autoscale docs, clarify cloud quota behavior vs max_instances. I'll own the incident report.
incident-bot: INC-2026-042 status -> mitigated (impact reduced). Owners: aj (SRE), luca (Infra), maya (CS). Next update due in 15m.
